mapper.sql: id, user_id, code_hash, purpose, expires_at, attempt_count, used_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT FROM verification_codes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT FROM ( SELECT FROM verification_codes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND used_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at > SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification_codes (user_id, code_hash, purpose, expires_at) VALUES ( #{code.userId}, #{code.codeHash}, #{code.purpose}, SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{expireMinutes}, 'MINUTE') )
